get.description: Retrieves a list of markups associated with the specified holder.  This endpoint supports the Contract and Potential Change Order tools.  Access requires the user to have admin permissions for the relevant tool.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: When set to `with_erp_data`, includes the `prime_line_item_id` field in the response.

applies_to_all.description: Indicates if the markup applies to all change management items within the holder.

compound.description: Details of the compound calculations for the markup.

selections.description: Specifies which existing markups to include in the calculation when 'selective' compounding is chosen.

type.description:
Type of calculation for the markup:
- **Basic Calculation (null):** Percentage is multiplied by the line items that meet the application criteria.
- **Compounds all Above (above):** Percentage is multiplied by the line items that meet the application criteria and all preceding markups in the markup table.
- **Selective Compounding (selective):** Percentage is multiplied by the line items that meet the application criteria and any individually selected markups.
- **Iterative Calculation or Margin (margin):** Percentage is multiplied by the line item total, including all markups.

holder_id.description: Unique identifier for the markup holder.

markup_conditions.description: Conditions that determine how the markup will be applied to change management items within the holder.

id.description: Unique identifier for the markup condition.

match_type.description: Specifies whether the condition includes or excludes items.

wbs_segment_id.description: Unique identifier for the WBS Segment associated with the markup condition.  Supported segments include Cost Type and Cost Code.

id.description: Unique identifier for the markup condition item.

wbs_segment_item_id.description: Unique identifier for the WBS Segment Item associated with the markup condition.  If the match type is 'includes' and the WBS Segment is Cost Type,  the markup will be applied to all change management items with the selected Cost Type.

markup_set.description:
Set of the markup.
- **Horizontal markup:** Calculates the markup amount on an individual line item.
- **Vertical markup:** Calculates the markup amount as a subtotal on all line items on a change order. 

Contracts use 'change_orders_horizontal' and 'change_orders_vertical'.  
Potential Change Orders use 'vertical' and 'horizontal'.

percentage.description: Percentage value of the markup. The default precision is 50.

position.description: Position of the markup in the markup set of the holder.  The default is the next available position, starting at 1.

prime_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Contract Line Item associated with the markup.  This ensures synchronization between the estimated value (without vertical markup) and  the revenue value (with vertical markup) in the integrated ERP system.  Applicable only to vertical markups on a prime contract or prime contract change order  when the ERP Integrations tool (Ryvit or Sage 300 CRE) is enabled. You need to pass query parameter `view=with_erp_data` to retrieve this value.

project_id.description: Unique identifier for the project associated with the markup.

tax_code_id.description: Canonical tax code identifier associated with the markup. This may point to a tax-group code (`is_group: true`) or an individual code. During dual-write migration, writes mirror the first id from `tax_code_ids` when that legacy array is provided. Sending only `tax_code_id: null` is a no-op; clear tax with `tax_code_ids: []`. Existing rows may still return null here until backfill or re-save.

funding_rule_id.description: Unique identifier of the funding rule assigned to this markup. Null when no funding rule is assigned. Pass an active project-level funding rule for this project on create or update; pass null to clear. Accepted on Prime Contract and Potential Change Order markups.

tax_code_ids.description: List of unique identifiers for tax codes associated with the markup. Applicable only when advanced calculations are enabled. Still supported during dual-write migration; when both fields are sent, this array is authoritative. Use an empty array to clear tax codes. The scalar `tax_code_id` stores only the first id from this list.

wbs_code.description: WBS Code to which the markup percentage will be applied on a project's budget.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WBS Code.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

During dual-write migration, writes mirror the first id from `tax_code_ids` when that legacy array is provided. Sending only `tax_code_id: null` is a no-op; clear tax with `tax_code_ids: []`. Existing rows may still return null here until backfill or re-save.

funding_rule_id.description: Unique identifier of the funding rule assigned to this markup. Null when no funding rule is assigned. Pass an active project-level funding rule for this project on create or update; pass null to clear. Accepted on Prime Contract and Potential Change Order markups.

tax_code_ids.description: List of unique identifiers for tax codes associated with the markup. Applicable only when advanced calculations are enabled. Still supported during dual-write migration; when both fields are sent, this array is authoritative. Use an empty array to clear tax codes. The scalar `tax_code_id` stores only the first id from this list.

wbs_code.description: WBS Code to which the markup percentage will be applied on a project's budget.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WBS Code.
